name: Touhou Chaotic Couple Comedy
source:
A Romantic Sitcom in Gensokyo starring a Chaotic Couple!

In this Visual Novel with Minigames, join Ichirin and Futo on their romantic misadventures, featuring kooky costumes, exciting card games, a giant floating cloud, and more!

[from [url=https://megapig9001.itch.io/touhou-chaotic-couple-comedy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以幻想乡为舞台，由一对混乱情侣主演的浪漫情景喜剧！

在这部包含小游戏的视觉小说中，陪伴一轮与布都，经历一连串恋爱乌龙。古怪服装、刺激的纸牌游戏、一大片漂浮的云，还有更多精彩内容！

[摘自[url=https://megapig9001.itch.io/touhou-chaotic-couple-comedy]itch.io[/url]]
